days: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Warm-up: bike + FIFA 11+ prep
exercises.focus: Bike 5 min easy; then FIFA 11+ style dynamic prep, ankle rocks, front-rack + thoracic mobility, deep bodyweight squat holds, 2-3 empty-bar clean drills. This neuromuscular warm-up is injury risk-reduction; do it every session.
exercises.progression: Keep easy all block; never turn into conditioning.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Spanish squat isometric
exercises.focus: Tendon prep (isometric phase of loading). Tolerable knee angle; upright trunk; equal pressure through both feet.
exercises.progression: Do not progress weekly. On a Yellow/Red tendon day or after long travel/sitting, use 5x45s instead of adding knee load elsewhere.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Hang power clean (EMOM every 90s)
exercises.logHint: Top load; bar-path & catch quality; any knee response
exercises.focus: Skill/power. Run as EMOM so it flows rhythmically instead of feeling brief - low reps protect bar speed, the EMOM gives the continuous 'into it' feel. Start above knee; full extension; fast elbows; shallow stable catch; controlled lower to thigh, no dropping. Stop the set if bar path loops or catch destabilises.
exercises.progression: One variable per week: W2 add density (E90s x8 x2). W3 +2.5 kg if all reps crisp. W4 deload E2min x5 x2 light. W5 5x2 power clean from floor @ RPE6-7. W6 E2min x4 x2 easy.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Heel-elevated front squat - top set
exercises.logHint: Top load; RPE-1; depth owned Y/N; knee pain during + next AM
exercises.focus: Main lower-body strength + clean receiving position. Heel-elevated (lifting shoes/wedge). If front rack limits an upright torso: use a 2-3 finger grip OR loop straps around the bar as handles. Only use a depth you can own with a vertical torso; no rebound out of the bottom. If the rack position still limits you, sub a heel-elevated Safety-Bar squat at the same RPE.
exercises.progression: W2 repeat or +2.5 kg only if Green. W3 top 4 @ RPE7.5. W4 deload 3x3 @ ~RPE6 (-15%). W5 1x3 @ RPE8 + back-offs. W6 2x3 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Heel-elevated front squat - back-off
exercises.logHint: Load; any form/knee change across sets
exercises.focus: Same heel elevation, grip option and depth as the top set. Stop a set the moment depth or knee position degrades.
exercises.progression: W2 hold 3x4. W3 same %. W4 2x3 (deload). W5 2x3 @ -8%. W6 included in 2x3 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.focus: Posterior-chain strength with minimal knee load. Lats engaged; soft knees; hips back; bar close.
exercises.progression: Add 5 kg only when all sets <=RPE6.5 AND Friday deadlift quality is unaffected.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Backward sled drag
exercises.logHint: Total load; knee response during + next AM (key knee-capacity driver)
exercises.focus: Knee-capacity / quad-tendon loading + low-impact conditioning - one of your best knee-friendly tools. Short controlled steps; stay tall; no sprinting. You occupy one turf lane; others can pass.
exercises.progression: Progress ONLY on Green weeks, one variable: W2 +1 rep (7x20m) OR W3 +10-20 kg (never both). W4 deload 4x20m. W5 return to progressed load. W6 4x20m easy.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Warm-up: row + banded shoulder prep
exercises.focus: Row 5 min easy; banded shoulder prep (wall slides, pull-aparts, external rotation, wrist extension, thoracic extension); empty-bar dip-and-drive drills.
exercises.progression: Keep unchanged.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Push jerk (EMOM every 90s)
exercises.focus: Skill as EMOM for rhythm (low reps keep the drive crisp with no missed reps). Shallow vertical dip; fast drive; receive in a quarter squat; full lockout; reset in the front rack. Bar must be light enough to return safely to the rack.
exercises.progression: W2 E90s x7 x2. W3 +2.5 kg if clean. W4 deload E2min x4 x2. W5 4x1 + push-press/jerk complex @ RPE7. W6 E2min x3 x2.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Bench press - top set
exercises.focus: Strength maintenance. Pause the first rep; leg drive without excessive lumbar extension.
exercises.progression: W2 +2.5 kg only if <=RPE7. W3 top set RPE7.5. W4 deload 2x5 @ -10%. W5 1x4 @ RPE8. W6 2x4 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Bench press - back-off
exercises.focus: Same controlled setup and bar path as the top set.
exercises.progression: W2 hold. W3 same. W4 2x5 (deload). W5 2x4. W6 included in 2x4 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
exercises.focus: Strict strength: full hang; chest leads toward bar; no kipping.
exercises.progression: Add 2.5 kg once all sets are clean at <=RPE6.5.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Bar muscle-up (skill)
exercises.focus: Gymnastics skill (no rings at your gym, so bar muscle-up). Clean kip, close bar path, active shoulders; strict or low-bar transition drills are fine. Never approach failure or chase a fatigue score.
exercises.progression: Add a 6th set only after 10 identical-quality reps; cap at 12 quality reps this block.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Deficit handstand push-up
exercises.focus: Deeper stretch as you preferred - set hands on plates/parallettes. Use the deeper range only while the neck stays neutral, shoulders stable and depth is repeatable. Stop before position deteriorates.
exercises.progression: Add 1 rep/set before increasing deficit; do not exceed RPE8.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Neck isometrics
exercises.focus: Rugby/contact robustness (cervical). Flexion, extension and both lateral directions; neutral spine, gradual build, no jerking. Very low footprint.
exercises.progression: Add 5 sec to a 40 sec cap, then add light band resistance.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Gymnastics + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Assault/air bike intervals
exercises.logHint: Avg watts/cal if shown; HR recovery between
exercises.focus: Aerobic-power conditioning; low impact so legs recover from Monday. Hard but controlled, not all-out; do not sprint the first interval. One bike = considerate footprint.
exercises.progression: W2 hold. W3 +1 interval only if Green AND Friday row unchanged. W4 deload 4 intervals. W5 hold hard volume, nudge output. W6 3 intervals.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Warm-up: ski/row + shoulder & hinge prep
exercises.focus: Ski or row 5 min easy; snatch-grip shoulder mobility; hip-hinge patterning; empty-bar overhead drills.
exercises.progression: Keep easy.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Hang power snatch / snatch high pull (EMOM 90s)
exercises.focus: Snatch skill + pulling-derivative power (pulls give the power stimulus with less eccentric/technical cost). EMOM for flow. Violent extension, long arms, vertical finish. Sub the snatch high pull (no catch) on any day the overhead catch position is off.
exercises.progression: W2 E90s x7. W3 +2.5 kg if crisp. W4 deload E2min x4. W5 5x2 hang power snatch @ RPE6. W6 E2min x3.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Incline barbell press
exercises.focus: Secondary pressing strength. Blades set; elbows slightly ahead of the bar.
exercises.progression: Add 2.5 kg when all 18 reps are <=RPE6.5.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.focus: CONTROLLED, not an explosive CrossFit pull (answering your question): explosive pulling is trained by the Olympic pulls/high pulls; this row builds controlled upper-back capacity for the front rack and overhead stability. Sternum on the pad; pull elbows toward hips at 30-45 deg; 1s hold at top; 2s lower.
exercises.progression: Add load only after 32 clean reps at the prescribed tempo.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Toes-to-bar
exercises.focus: CrossFit gymnastics + trunk; hanging so it is knee-friendly. Controlled kip or strict; stop before form degrades.
exercises.progression: Add 1-2 reps/set to 12, then introduce small kip cycling for capacity.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Nordic hamstring eccentric
exercises.focus: Rugby posterior robustness - NHE roughly halves hamstring-strain risk. Lower as slowly as you can control; hands ready to catch. Expect high DOMS early, so start conservative. Minimal patellar-tendon load.
exercises.progression: W1-2 hold 3x4-5. Add 1 rep before adding range. Reduce if it compromises Friday deadlift quality.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.focus: Groin/adductor robustness (Copenhagen) + pelvic stability for change-of-direction. Keep shoulder, pelvis and knee stacked.
exercises.progression: Add 5 sec weekly to a 40 sec cap, then progress lever length.

exercises.day: Day 3 (Thu) - Snatch/Pull Skill + Upper Capacity + Prehab + Aerobic-Power Row
exercises.name: Row erg intervals (aerobic-power tempo)
exercises.focus: Aerobic-power/tempo conditioning kept sub-maximal to protect Friday's deadlift (>=24h heavy-lower separation). Rate 24-28; strong smooth leg drive; low impact. One rower = considerate footprint.
exercises.progression: W2 hold. W3 push split faster OR add a rep - one variable. W4 deload 3x2min. W5 hold volume, nudge pace. W6 2x2min.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: Warm-up: bike + hinge prep + neck iso
exercises.focus: Bike 5 min easy; hip-hinge patterning; posterior activation; 2nd neck-isometric dose (2x20-30s each direction).
exercises.progression: Keep easy.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: Clean pull from blocks/hang (power, fresh)
exercises.focus: Olympic pulling derivative trained in a FRESH state (power must be fresh - Rule 3). Violent vertical extension, long arms, no early arm bend. Terminate if bar speed drops. Knee-light.
exercises.progression: Add 2.5-5 kg only if bar speed stays high and there is no increase in knee response.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: Deadlift - top set
exercises.logHint: Top load; RPE-1; low-back & knee response
exercises.focus: Strength-maintenance hinge. Reset every rep; no touch-and-go; hard brace + lat tension.
exercises.progression: W2 repeat or +2.5-5 kg if Green. W3 top 3 @ RPE7.5. W4 deload 2x3 (-15%). W5 1x2 @ RPE8. W6 2x2 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: Deadlift - back-off
exercises.focus: Same brace and reset as the top set; no touch-and-go.
exercises.progression: W2 hold. W3 same. W4 2x3 (deload). W5 2x2. W6 included in 2x2 @ RPE6.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.focus: Unilateral posterior stability + rugby robustness with minimal patellar stress. Hips square; tripod foot; soft knee; long spine.
exercises.progression: Add 2-4 kg only when balance and pelvic position are unchanged on all reps.

exercises.day: Day 4 (Fri) - Deadlift + Barbell-Cycling MetCon
exercises.name: MetCon: power clean + bike couplet
exercises.logHint: Rounds; clean load; did form/knee hold; how it felt (did you get 'into it'?)
exercises.focus: This is your rhythmic barbell-cycling 'getting into it' piece - deliberately under fatigue (a CrossFit competency) but tendon-first: cleans (hinge-dominant) + bike, with NO squatting-under-fatigue, no wall balls, no jumping. Footprint = one barbell at your rack + one bike (<=2 stations); keep plates tidy. Stop a round if the catch collapses into a deep knee-heavy squat or the bar path loops.
exercises.progression: W1 4 rounds for quality with full rest. W2 cut rest to 60s (density - one variable). W3 5 rounds. W4 deload 3 rounds easy @ RPE6. W5 benchmark for time/quality - record time + load. W6 3 rounds easy, then retest the benchmark fresh if Green.
